items.html: (And I do not know how to connect all these opinions, unless we say that they are in the manner of what was mentioned above concerning the clothing of the seven lower ones of Atik in Arich, where we said that the seven themselves clothe in the entire body of Arich. However, from their seven branches, which are included in the Hesed of Atik, which is in the Keter of Arich, they also expanded in the seven of the Galgalta of Arich. And likewise in our case here, for all the NHY themselves expanded in the entire body of ZA, but the essence of their illumination remains in the three first ones, the Mochin of ZA, as it seems to me. I also saw another variation concerning the Tifferet of Arich, for I once heard that he gave his entire lower half to ZA, but most of the times I heard, precisely, that it is only the lower third alone; and I do not know their resolution, unless we say in the manner of the Tifferet of Ima, which clothes in the Keter of ZA, for when he has only the Mochin of Ima, he takes only her third, and when he also has the Mochin of Aba, he takes her half, as mentioned, see there. And likewise will it be here, as it seems to me. It is also possible that they may be understood in the matter of the variation of the three phases that ZA has at the time of the pregnancy, as above, at the beginning of this chapter, and according to the phase the clothing will vary. And this, too, is correct, as it seems to me. Also, in what is said concerning the three upper ones in the three chambers, this too will be explained, according to what was mentioned above. (From R. Chaim Vital, of blessed memory).
